objective: Build the owner-company priority watchlist layer so a plain list of company names can be dropped in later and immediately become a first-class discovery source. Resolve each company to its official careers/ATS surface, run company+role-family web research in addition to Company Watch, preserve provenance, and send findings through the same unified discovery/semantic/eligibility/dedupe funnel. The watchlist is additive to broad-market search, never a replacement.
prerequisites: agent-career-codex-style-open-web-job-research-2026-09-24 must reach a truthful terminal state.
Reuse the unified discovery schema/funnel and web-research collector from the prerequisite.
allowed_scope: Create a simple owner-editable watchlist input format accepting company names with optional careers URLs/notes; an empty list must be valid so infrastructure can finish before the owner supplies names.
Implement deterministic company identity normalization/aliases so duplicate spellings collapse without merging distinct companies.

For each watchlist company, discover and verify the official careers page and ATS host where possible; support common ATS families including Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, Teamtailor, Workable and region-specific ATS surfaces discovered by the web-research lane.
Run two complementary query families per company: official-careers/ATS discovery and company-name + early-career cyber role-family web research. Do not rely on one ATS URL alone.
Give watchlist findings a priority_watchlist provenance flag and surface them prominently in the Chief/Career brief, but do not bypass semantic or deterministic eligibility gates.
Keep historical/current Company Watch registry data reusable; do not duplicate its state. Merge source provenance when Company Watch and web research find the same vacancy.
Record per-company health: last checked, careers source found/not found, queries executed, live vacancies observed, candidates after funnel, access/blocking reason, and next retry.

Add acceptance fixtures for aliases, ATS discovery, company with no careers page, company with zero matching roles, duplicate vacancy from Company Watch + web research, and a watchlist vacancy that remains visible even when not top-ranked globally.
No canonical tracker writes during acceptance; produce read-only manifests/brief sections only.
stop_conditions: No fabricated careers URLs or vacancies.
No employer/recruiter contact, applications or account mutation.
No browser/GUI automation or signed-in session use.
A company with inaccessible careers infrastructure must be labelled unavailable/unknown, not 'no jobs'.
notes: Owner will provide the actual company list later. This task should make adding that list a data/config step, not another engineering project.
